reuse.why: Edits only the existing getRangeAmount and getExpectedAmount, which every consumer (getScheduledAmount, forecast, posting, action sync, schedule template, API model) already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule change is two expressions in the shared definitions.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines how schedule amounts are planned.

scope.why: Two expression changes, updated comments and tests, plus a release note as the repo's upcoming-release-notes convention expects.

maintainability.why: Simpler code (Math.min, amount - threshold) in the single place the rule lives, with comments that state the new intent.
